alt.en: Generic wall-mounted and floor-standing cabinet options in a technical showroom
alt.sw: Mfano wa cabinet ya ukutani na rack ya kusimama kwenye chumba cha vifaa

intro.en: Make room for the equipment—and the work around it. Choose mounting, usable depth and ventilation before choosing a height.
intro.sw: Panga nafasi ya vifaa na nafasi ya kuvifanyia kazi. Chagua sehemu ya kufunga, kina cha matumizi na uingizaji hewa kabla ya kuchagua urefu.

options.en: Size enquiries: 4U, 6U, 9U, 12U, 15U, 18U, 22U, 27U, 32U, 37U and 42U. Supply, mounting format and dimensions must be confirmed for each quotation.
options.sw: Chaguo za kuombea bei: 4U, 6U, 9U, 12U, 15U, 18U, 22U, 27U, 32U, 37U na 42U. Upatikanaji, aina ya ufungaji na vipimo huthibitishwa kwenye kila makadirio.

points.en: Wall-mounted: assess the wall, cabinet weight, cable entry and safe access. A small patching point has different needs from a server rack.
points.sw: Ya ukutani: hakiki uimara wa ukuta, uzito, njia ya nyaya na nafasi ya kufikia vifaa. Sehemu ndogo ya patching ina mahitaji tofauti na rack ya seva.

points.en: Floor-standing: plan floor space, equipment weight, service access and future expansion. Do not select a 42U enclosure by height alone.
points.sw: Ya kusimama: panga nafasi sakafuni, uzito wa vifaa, nafasi ya matengenezo na upanuzi. Usichague rack ya 42U kwa urefu pekee.

points.en: Confirm mounting width and usable equipment depth against actual switches, UPS, servers and bend clearance. External depth is not usable mounting depth.
points.sw: Linganisha upana wa kufungia na kina kinachotumika na swichi, UPS, seva na nafasi ya kupinda nyaya. Kina cha nje si sawa na kina cha kufungia vifaa.

points.en: Specify door and ventilation needs, shelves, cable organisers, fans and PDU separately. Their inclusion, load ratings and electrical arrangements are quotation-specific.
points.sw: Ainisha milango, uingizaji hewa, shelf, cable organiser, feni na PDU kando. Vifaa vinavyojumuishwa, uwezo wa kubeba na mpangilio wa umeme huthibitishwa kwenye makadirio.

check.en: Send your equipment list, mounting preference, available space and photos of the installation area. We will confirm U height, width, usable depth, load and accessories.
check.sw: Tuma orodha ya vifaa, aina ya ufungaji unayopendelea, nafasi iliyopo na picha za eneo. Tutahakiki urefu wa U, upana, kina cha matumizi, uzito na vifaa vya ziada.

faq.en: Count rack-mounted equipment, patch panels and organisers, then allow working clearance and expansion. Equipment depth, load and heat can rule out a cabinet even when the U count fits.
faq.sw: Hesabu vifaa vya kufungwa, patch panel na organiser, kisha acha nafasi ya kazi na upanuzi. Kina, uzito na joto vinaweza kufanya cabinet isifae hata kama U zinatosha.

faq.en: Are fans, shelves and a PDU included?
Only if listed in the agreed quotation. Confirm each accessory and its fit; the family photograph is not a promise of an included kit.
faq.sw: Ni pale tu vinapoainishwa kwenye makadirio yaliyokubaliwa. Hakiki kila kifaa na uoanifu wake; picha ya kundi si ahadi ya seti kamili.

pointTitles.sw: Milango, hewa na vifaa vya ziada

alt.en: Generic grey and black cable coils, a blue patch lead, faceplate and patch panel
alt.sw: Mfano wa koili za nyaya za kijivu na nyeusi, patch cord ya bluu, faceplate na patch panel

intro.en: From the cabinet to the desk, camera or access point. Specify the cable, its route and the complete termination system together.
intro.sw: Kutoka cabinet hadi dawati, kamera au access point. Ainisha nyaya, njia yake na vifaa vyote vya termination kama mfumo mmoja.

options.en: Indoor CAT6 · outdoor CAT6 · patch cords · keystones · faceplates · RJ45 connectors · patch panels · cable management.
options.sw: CAT6 za ndani · CAT6 za nje · patch cord · keystone · faceplate · connector za RJ45 · patch panel · vifaa vya kupanga nyaya.

points.en: BM handles grey and black CAT6; blue is also a familiar cable colour. Colour alone does not prove conductor material, shielding, jacket type or outdoor suitability.
points.sw: BM hushughulikia CAT6 za kijivu na nyeusi; bluu pia ni rangi inayotumika. Rangi pekee haithibitishi aina ya conductor, shielding, jacket au kufaa kwa matumizi ya nje.

points.en: Indoor/outdoor: assess UV, moisture, route, containment and building-entry requirements. Ask for the exact cable datasheet rather than assuming a black jacket is outdoor rated.
points.sw: Ndani/nje: tathmini jua, unyevu, njia, containment na mahitaji ya kuingia jengoni. Omba datasheet ya nyaya halisi badala ya kudhani jacket nyeusi inafaa nje.

points.en: Pure-copper and shielded/unshielded enquiries need verified manufacturer specifications. Confirm conductor construction, compatible jacks/plugs and any bonding requirements before ordering.
points.sw: Maombi ya pure copper na shielded/unshielded yanahitaji vipimo vilivyothibitishwa vya mtengenezaji. Hakiki conductor, jack/plug zinazofaa na mahitaji ya bonding kabla ya kuagiza.

points.en: Agree outlet counts, route lengths, patching, labels and the test scope. PoE needs a complete assessment of switch power, cable, connectors and device demand.
points.sw: Kubalianeni idadi ya outlet, urefu wa njia, patching, lebo na vipimo vya kufanya. PoE inahitaji tathmini ya umeme wa swichi, nyaya, connector na mahitaji ya kifaa.

check.en: Send indoor/outdoor routes, outlet counts, estimated lengths, device/PoE needs and any required cable specification. No conductor or jacket grade is assumed.
check.sw: Tuma njia za ndani/nje, idadi ya outlet, makadirio ya urefu, vifaa/mahitaji ya PoE na vipimo vya nyaya vinavyotakiwa. Aina ya conductor au jacket haidhaniwi.

faq.en: Does black CAT6 mean outdoor or pure copper?
faq.sw: CAT6 nyeusi ni ya nje au pure copper?

faq.en: No. Check the exact manufacturer specification for conductor and environmental rating; colour is an identification choice.
faq.sw: Hapana. Hakiki vipimo vya mtengenezaji kuhusu conductor na matumizi yanayoruhusiwa; rangi ni chaguo la utambulisho.

faq.en: Can you quote a complete outlet installation?
faq.sw: Mnaweza kutoa bei ya outlet yenye ufungaji kamili?

faq.en: Yes—request cable routes, outlets, terminations, patching, cabinet work and agreed testing in one scope, rather than cable alone.
faq.sw: Ndiyo—omba njia za nyaya, outlet, termination, patching, kazi ya cabinet na vipimo vilivyokubaliwa katika wigo mmoja, badala ya nyaya pekee.

pointTitles.sw: Nyaya za ndani na za nje

alt.en: Generic fibre preparation and splicing workbench with protected termination materials
alt.sw: Mfano wa meza ya kuandaa na kuunganisha fibre yenye vifaa vya kulinda termination

intro.en: Plan the route before the roll. Building-to-building and campus links need the right fibre, construction and protected termination at both ends.
intro.sw: Panga njia kabla ya kuagiza koili. Viungo kati ya majengo na kampasi vinahitaji fibre inayofaa, muundo sahihi wa nyaya na termination iliyolindwa pande zote.

options.en: Indoor/outdoor application · single-mode/multimode · required core count · installation construction · route length or roll requirement. All exact specifications are confirmed against the BOQ.
options.sw: Matumizi ya ndani/nje · single-mode/multimode · idadi ya core · muundo wa nyaya kulingana na ufungaji · urefu wa njia au koili. Vipimo halisi huthibitishwa kwa BOQ.

points.en: Assess ducts, aerial or other proposed routes, exposure, pull conditions and building entry. Construction, protection and local installation constraints determine the cable choice.
points.sw: Tathmini duct, njia za juu au njia nyingine, mazingira, uvutaji na kuingia jengoni. Muundo, kinga na hali za ufungaji ndizo huongoza uchaguzi.

points.en: Specify single-mode or multimode around the link design and supported optics. Core count must cover the actual links and agreed spare capacity; more cores do not automatically make a faster link.
points.sw: Ainisha single-mode au multimode kulingana na kiungo na optics zinazokubaliwa. Idadi ya core izingatie viungo na akiba iliyokubaliwa; core nyingi si lazima ziongeze kasi.

points.en: Match transceiver speed, fibre type, wavelength, distance and optical budget at both ends. A fibre link still needs appropriate powered equipment; fibre does not carry PoE.
points.sw: Linganisha kasi ya transceiver, aina ya fibre, wavelength, umbali na optical budget pande zote. Kiungo bado kinahitaji vifaa vyenye umeme; fibre haipitishi PoE.

points.en: Quote route length with agreed installation allowance, splicing, enclosures, patch cords and loss/continuity tests. Specialist OTDR reports are scoped explicitly, not assumed.
points.sw: Omba urefu wa njia wenye akiba ya ufungaji iliyokubaliwa, splicing, box, patch cord na vipimo vya loss/continuity. Ripoti maalumu za OTDR huainishwa wazi, hazidhaniwi.

check.en: Send a route sketch, building distances, indoor/outdoor sections, existing fibre/optics and required links or core count. Ask for materials only or complete link delivery.
check.sw: Tuma mchoro wa njia, umbali wa majengo, sehemu za ndani/nje, fibre/optics zilizopo na viungo au core zinazotakiwa. Omba vifaa pekee au utekelezaji wa kiungo kamili.

faq.en: Can I order only by length and colour?
faq.sw: Naweza kuagiza kwa urefu na rangi pekee?

faq.en: No. Confirm fibre type, core count, construction and environmental/installation requirements. The exact cable must match the designed link.
faq.sw: Hapana. Hakiki aina ya fibre, idadi ya core, muundo na mazingira/ufungaji. Nyaya halisi lazima zilingane na mpango wa kiungo.

faq.en: Will fibre also power cameras at another building?
faq.sw: Fibre itapeleka pia umeme kwa kamera jengo jingine?

faq.en: No. Plan power, local switching/PoE and protection at the remote end separately from the optical data link.
faq.sw: Hapana. Panga umeme, swichi/PoE na kinga upande wa pili kando na kiungo cha data cha fibre.

pointTitles.sw: Aina ya fibre na idadi ya core

title.sw: Patch cord na vifaa vya fibre

alt.en: Generic fibre patch cords, distribution box, splice tray and capped transceiver, shown as separate options
alt.sw: Mfano wa patch cord za fibre, distribution box, splice tray na transceiver yenye kifuniko, kama chaguo tofauti

intro.en: Match every end. Connector shape, polish, fibre type and optical equipment must agree—not just the colour of the cable.
intro.sw: Linganisha kila ncha. Umbo la connector, polish, aina ya fibre na vifaa vya optics lazima vioane—si rangi ya nyaya pekee.

options.en: LC–LC · SC–SC · LC–SC · UPC/APC · simplex/duplex · pigtails · adapters/couplers · ODF/distribution boxes · splice trays/closures · SFP modules · media converters · patch panels and cable management.
options.sw: LC–LC · SC–SC · LC–SC · UPC/APC · simplex/duplex · pigtail · adapter/coupler · ODF/distribution box · splice tray/closure · moduli za SFP · media converter · patch panel na cable management.

points.en: LC and SC describe connector families; UPC and APC describe end-face polish. Do not directly mate UPC to APC. Record the connector and polish needed at each end.
points.sw: LC na SC ni aina za connector; UPC na APC ni aina za polish ya ncha. Usiunganishe UPC moja kwa moja na APC. Andika aina ya connector na polish inayotakiwa kila upande.

points.en: Choose LC–LC, SC–SC or LC–SC to suit the actual ports, with matching fibre type, simplex/duplex arrangement and length. A mixed-connector cord does not itself convert optical standards.
points.sw: Chagua LC–LC, SC–SC au LC–SC kulingana na port halisi, aina ya fibre, simplex/duplex na urefu. Patch cord yenye connector tofauti haibadilishi yenyewe viwango vya optics.

points.en: Pigtails, couplers, splice trays, closures and ODF/fibre distribution boxes need the correct port capacity, connector types and installation protection. If your BOQ says ADP, confirm the exact panel/box intended.
points.sw: Pigtail, coupler, splice tray, closure na ODF/distribution box zinahitaji uwezo sahihi wa port, connector na kinga ya ufungaji. BOQ ikiandika ADP, hakiki panel/box inayomaanishwa.

points.en: SFP/SFP+ modules and media converters require host support, speed, fibre type, wavelength and optical-budget checks. Two SFP slots on different devices do not prove compatibility.
points.sw: Moduli za SFP/SFP+ na media converter zinahitaji hakiki ya host, kasi, aina ya fibre, wavelength na optical budget. Slot za SFP kwenye vifaa viwili hazithibitishi uoanifu.

check.en: Send clear photos or exact labels of both ports, fibre type, connector/polish at each end, length, simplex/duplex and quantities. Never look into a fibre port to identify it.
check.sw: Tuma picha au lebo halisi za port zote mbili, aina ya fibre, connector/polish kila mwisho, urefu, simplex/duplex na idadi. Usiangalie ndani ya port ya fibre ili kuitambua.

faq.en: Can an LC–SC cord connect any two optical devices?
faq.sw: LC–SC inaweza kuunganisha vifaa vyovyote vya optics?

faq.en: No. Physical ends are only one part of compatibility. Confirm polish, fibre type, optical standards, wavelength and the supported transmit/receive arrangement.
faq.sw: Hapana. Ncha ni sehemu moja tu ya uoanifu. Hakiki polish, aina ya fibre, viwango vya optics, wavelength na mpangilio wa kutuma/kupokea unaokubaliwa.

faq.en: Can you quote a full fibre termination kit?
faq.sw: Mnaweza kuandaa makadirio ya vifaa vyote vya termination?

faq.en: Yes, against an assessed link or BOQ. List patching, pigtails, distribution, splicing and optics explicitly; no universal kit or included accessories are assumed.
faq.sw: Ndiyo, kwa kiungo kilichotathminiwa au BOQ. Orodhesha patching, pigtail, distribution, splicing na optics wazi; hakuna seti au vifaa vinavyodhaniwa kujumuishwa.

pointTitles.sw: Ncha, urefu na aina ya fibre
